purpose: isolate counting-anchor stability from association; experimental postprocessor only
hypothesis: A fixed spatial confirmation band may reduce noisy bottom-anchor recrossings, but can miss real shallow passages, band-start/end crossings or delay reporting. Any such safety regression blocks acceptance.

candidate_rules.initialization: no inferred origin inside band; wait for first stable side
candidate_rules.pending: last adjacent frozen-rule line arrival toward opposite stable side; cancel on strict return to origin half-plane
candidate_rules.confirmation: first adjacent sample on opposite stable side; consume pending arrival even if outside segment or already emitted
candidate_rules.event_time: retain interpolated pending line-arrival time and X; separately record integer confirmation frame
candidate_rules.gap: nonadjacent same-ID sample cancels pending and reinitializes side; never join IDs or fill gaps
candidate_rules.end: pending arrivals remain unconfirmed; no end-of-run flush or fabricated confirmation
candidate_rules.deduplication: first confirmed in-segment arrival per ID and direction across whole run
candidate_rules.segment: -6 <= interpolated line-arrival X < 6; use crossing X, not confirmation X

path_rule: one object with ID 1; each waypoint is [integer frame, world X, world Y]; float64 piecewise linear interpolation including endpoints; do not round crossing times

grid.ordering: registered scenario, seed, condition, pass, counter order
grid.pairing: one immutable public-row vector per tracker pass, projected identically and consumed by both counters; not two tracker variants

evaluation.truth: legacy line-arrival rule on ideal world paths, never band-filtered; at most two truth events per case
evaluation.primary: mean bottom-centre missed-plus-extra events over ten seeds and box_error_only/combined, separately per scenario
evaluation.confirmation_delay: confirmation frame minus retained interpolated line-arrival time, for every emitted candidate event including extras
evaluation.emission_window_count_error: sum absolute predicted-minus-truth counts per direction per half-open 30-frame window, using integer emission frames for predictions and exact ideal crossing times for truth
evaluation.retain: all 37 parent endpoints for both counters, both timestamp/emission window tables, each emission frame/delay, pending/cancellation diagnostics, all seeds and conditions including null/zero-truth cases
evaluation.null_policy: no matched crossings gives null conditional errors, not zero; no emitted events gives null maximum delay, not a latency success
evaluation.inference: descriptive synthetic screening only; no independence claim for seeds, statistical significance, real-world accuracy or novelty claim

execution_policy.heldout_policy: commit full reviewed harness and environment/input hashes; one exclusive opening; stop on first error; retain partial evidence; no retry, selective run or overwritten result
execution_policy.invalidity_policy: document versioned amendment and fresh validation; never revive an opened set
